2026-10-02 fresh-context review (independent subagent, read-only). It confirmed inverse direction, provider semantics, that no unsolved iterate can be placed, affine ordering, the oracle generator, and no lattice leftovers. Findings applied:
(2) A non-commuting multi-affine test, mutation-checked: reversing the composition fails it.
(3) Typed InverseFailureKind replaces the string-keyed summary map; PointwiseInverseUnsupported wraps PointMapError.
(4) InversePolicy builds provider settings once in make (typed Left, no throw); Default derives from make.
(5) FrameBridge.exactness is an exhaustive match.
(6) inverseSummary is decided by bridge use and counts NotQueried vertices.
(7) Exact failure kinds and iteration counts are asserted; wall-clock P6-JVM is asserted only with SCALAFIM_TIMING_BUDGETS=1 (budget unchanged).
(8) Fields renamed worstResidualMm / worstIterations.
(9) Receipts use stable labels.
(10) At commit, the branch will be collapsed into one commit on c6030454 so the lattice WIP never lands.
Finding (1), the reframe4s pin bump, awaits the build.sbt reservation (codex-atlas-oct02 until 17:00Z) or a user override. Reference suites after the fixes: JVM 92/92 (real assets required), JS 70 + 2 opt-in skips, no warnings.
